name: Jericoacoara
tagline: Sand-street village of dunes, lagoons and kites
summary: Jericoacoara is a sandy-street village in a national park on Brazil's northeast coast, reached only by 4x4. Watch sunset from the giant Sunset Dune, see the Pedra Furada rock arch, swing in hammocks over the water at Lagoa do Paraíso, and kitesurf in some of the world's most reliable winds.
seasonNote: July to December is windy and dry; rainy season is roughly February to May.
arrival: Fly to Jericoacoara (Cruz) airport or Fortaleza, then transfer; the last stretch is by 4x4 on the dunes.
gettingAround: Walk the village; buggies and 4x4s to lagoons.
cashTip: Cards and Pix work almost everywhere; carry some reais for beach vendors. A 10 percent service charge is usually added.
foodTip: Tapioca crêpes, fresh fish, and caipirinhas on the beach.
